title: Silicon nanocantilever 500 x 50 x 15 nm: thermoelastic damping (3D eigenfrequency)
description:
The cantilever of silicon_nanocantilever_modes_3d (L = 500 nm along x, w = 50 nm along y, t = 15 nm along z, library silicon, fixed on x_lo, uniform 5 nm cubes of 6 quadratic tetrahedra each) with a thermoelastic_damping feature at T0 = 293.15 K: per mode the strain-rate heat source drives the heat equation on the beam (adiabatic on every face, the clamp included) and the out-of-phase part of the thermal stress gives Q_TED. Library silicon thermal data: rho = 2329 kg/m^3, cp = 700 J/(kg K), alpha = 2.6e-6 1/K, k = k_beam (default 130 W/(m K), the bulk value). Eigenfrequency study, 5 lowest modes (out-of-plane flexure 1 ~82 MHz, in-plane flexure 1 ~270 MHz, out-of-plane flexure 2 ~509 MHz, torsion 1 and out-of-plane flexure 3 near 1.4 GHz).
No reference (the undamped frequencies are graded in silicon_nanocantilever_modes_3d). For orientation, Zener's thin-beam estimate 1 / Q = Delta omega tau / (1 + (omega tau)^2), Delta = E alpha^2 T0 / (rho cp) = 2.0e-4, tau = h^2 rho cp / (pi^2 k) with h the thickness the heat crosses (t out of plane, w in plane), is the parameter Q_zener_*: far below the Debye peak here (omega tau ~1.5e-4 out of plane, ~5e-3 in plane), so 1 / Q ~ Delta omega tau and Q_TED ~3.4e7 (out-of-plane 1), ~9e5 (in-plane 1), ~5.4e6 (out-of-plane 2). In this regime Q_TED grows in proportion to k.
Caveat: the feature is continuum Fourier heat flow. At 15 nm the phonon mean free path of silicon (~100-300 nm at room temperature) exceeds the thickness, so the in-film conductivity is several times below bulk (thin-film measurements ~20-30 W/(m K) near 20 nm: set k_beam), and tau (~3e-13 s at bulk k) approaches phonon relaxation times, where Fourier TED is only an estimate.
Derived values tab: q_ted_oop1, q_ted_ip1, q_ted_oop2 (Q_TED of each mode, picked from the damping table by a +-10 % frequency window) and shift_oop1 (ted_frequency_shift of mode 1: relative rise toward the adiabatic stiffness). The damping table itself (solid.ted) lists every mode.

parameters.name: dx_mesh
parameters.description: uniform cell size (3 cells over t, 10 over w, 100 along L; each cell 6 tetrahedra)

parameters.name: k_beam
parameters.description: thermal conductivity [W/(m K)]: library silicon 130 (bulk); a 15 nm film is several times lower (phonon boundary scattering)

parameters.name: c_bend
parameters.description: sqrt(E / (12 rho)) [m/s]: Euler-Bernoulli f_n = (beta_n L)^2 h c_bend / (2 pi L^2)

parameters.name: f_ip1
parameters.description: Euler-Bernoulli in-plane flexure 1 [Hz] (mode window; the 3D mode is ~0.75 % lower)

parameters.name: wtau_oop1
parameters.description: omega tau of out-of-plane flexure 1 (heat across t)

parameters.name: wtau_ip1
parameters.description: omega tau of in-plane flexure 1 (heat across w)

parameters.name: wtau_oop2
parameters.description: omega tau of out-of-plane flexure 2 (heat across t)
